candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The Nusselt number is a dimensionless measure of convective to conductive heat transport. Using the provided seven physical inputs one can form the Rayleigh and Prandtl numbers (Ra = g·alpha·delta_T·h^3/(nu·kappa), Pr = nu/kappa) which are dimensionless; Nu is then a function of these dimensionless groups. All input variable dimensions are standard and thus known with high confidence.

Thermal diffusivity of the fluid (thermal conductivity divided by volumetric heat capacity).
